seo.title: PrimaSTEM | Privacy Policy
seo.description: PrimaSTEM privacy policy. GDPR-compliant. Data collection, processing, your rights.

sections.sidebarText: Information about the entity responsible for processing your personal data.
sections.body:
#### PRIMASTEM SAS

11 rue de Magdebourg, 75016 Paris, France  
SIRET: 944 985 720 00019  
Email: info@primastem.com

#### Data we collect

- When you write to us at info@primastem.com: your email address, your name and anything you include in your message.
- When you book a meeting through Google Calendar: the name and email address you enter when booking. The booking is handled by Google under its own privacy policy.
- Only with your consent: visit statistics through Google Analytics, such as the pages you open, your device and browser type, and your approximate location.

#### Purpose of processing

The data we collect is used to:

- Respond to your information requests
- Process your orders
- Contact you in the context of a business partnership
- Measure site visits to understand what people read (only with your consent)

sections.sidebarText: Information about the legal basis for processing and your GDPR rights.
sections.body:
#### Legal basis

The processing of your data is based on:

- Your consent (article 6.1.a GDPR)
- The performance of a contract (article 6.1.b GDPR)
- Our legitimate interest (article 6.1.f GDPR)

#### Recipients of the data

Your emails and order data are processed only by the PrimaSTEM team. If you accept cookies, visit data is received by Google Ireland Limited as the provider of Google Analytics. Google may process it outside the EU, including in the United States. There are no other recipients, except where legally required.

#### Retention period

Data is retained for 3 years from the last contact.

#### Your rights

Under the GDPR, you have the following rights:

- Right of access
- Right to rectification
- Right to erasure
- Right to restriction of processing
- Right to data portability
- Right to object

To exercise these rights, contact us: info@primastem.com

You can also lodge a complaint with the CNIL (www.cnil.fr).

sections.sidebarText: Information about cookie usage and updates to this policy.
sections.body:
#### Cookies

The site sets no cookies without your consent. On your first visit, a banner with Decline and Accept buttons appears at the bottom of the screen.

If you click Accept, Google Analytics sets the `_ga` and `_ga_QGPVQ44DNN` cookies for visit statistics. They are kept for up to 13 months.

Your choice is saved in your browser for 13 months, after which the banner asks again. You can change your mind at any time with the Cookie settings link at the bottom of every page. If you decline, the Google Analytics cookies are deleted.

#### Hosting

This site is hosted by Cloudflare, Inc., 101 Townsend Street, San Francisco, California 94107, USA.

#### Updates

We reserve the right to modify this policy at any time. The date of last update is shown at the top of this page.
